about: Two planted defects, applied only to the benchmark copy of the source: a run reaches a contract that asks for an independent owner on evidence nobody independent holds; and a mission with no acceptance criterion counts as verified.

mutations.find: const reached = (c) => c.rows.some((r) => atLeast(r.level, c.unit.verificationContract.min) && (c.unit.verificationContract.owner !== "independent" || r.independent));
